scope: Offline expired Lease release helper; not live recovery evidence
behavioral_coverage: exact six-operation identity and resourceVersion CAS
invalid duration and Lease UID/resourceVersion/holder mismatch rejected
client/fence/signer desired replicas and legacy controller rejected
initial and second-read Pod presence rejected
retained PVC UID mismatch or unbound phase rejected
API failure and CAS race rejected without forced retry
post-mutation readback failure returns critical exit 70
test_isolation: PRIVATE_EKS_SESSION=1; mock kubectl; AWS deny stub; synthetic identities only
limitations: exclusive maintenance and GitOps pause are operator attestations, not an atomic lock
Lease CAS cannot atomically prevent another controller mutation
live release, signer recovery and post-recovery duty not executed
